agent_notes: Major finding: nearly every indexed online record of a 'Ladera' in Bikaner district points to a village in BIKANER TEHSIL (census code 069062, Gram Panchayat area near Malasar/Katariasar/Jamsar, ~43km from Bikaner city) — not to Lunkaransar tehsil or Mahajan sub-tehsil where the 34-gaon Ladera should sit. Indiankanoon court filings independently corroborate this same Malasar/Jamsar location for 'Village Ladera'. This is almost certainly a DIFFERENT, still-inhabited Ladera (pop. 475, Census 2011) than the one acquired for MFFR in 1982-84 — flagged direct_mention:false throughout. A much stronger geographic match for the 34-gaon unit is 'Lalera Patta Mahajan' (लालेरा पट्टा महाजन, census code 069226), which IS in Lunkaransar tehsil near Mahajan/Baladesar/Suratgarh — spelling differs by one consonant (Lalera vs Ladera), a plausible transliteration/dialect variant worth a human researcher's attention. No search (web, news, Hindi, legal, video, social) surfaced any content about firing-range acquisition, displacement, Dhatarwal clan history, temples, or oral history for either spelling — consistent with this being a small evacuated/absorbed hamlet with no digital footprint. Google/DuckDuckGo full search returned CAPTCHA (not bypassed, per rules); Bing and DuckDuckGo via WebFetch returned irrelevant results (Ladera Texas/California/St. Lucia real-estate and resort listings dominate). jatland.com and web.archive.org were unreachable (403 / blocked) in this session. WebSearch tool hit a session-wide budget cap after 6 successful calls; remaining Tier 1/2 queries could not be run and should be retried by a future pass, especially the Hindi displacement-specific queries (लाडेरा महाजन फायरिंग रेंज विस्थापित) which never returned results.
